claims.text: 2025 totals: In its report dated 30 January 2026, PTS recorded, for 2025, 322 reports submitted by businesses about accessibility shortcomings and 114 complaints from the public. It opened 17 e-commerce supervision cases and 11 product market-surveillance cases during 2025. The report described these checks as ongoing.
claims.legal_basis: Lag (2023:254), identified in section 6.1 and footnote 41.
claims.stage_detail: Report describes supervision and product checks as ongoing; counts of reports and complaints do not establish violations or penalties.

sources.passage: Factual paraphrase: 2025 submissions comprised 322 operator reports of accessibility shortcomings and 114 public complaints. PTS initiated 17 e-commerce cases and 11 product cases in 2025; checks ongoing. E-commerce concerned larger operators established in Sweden selling products; product checks concerned PCs, smartphones and tablets.
